831: ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਨਉ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
I hold that the yogic practices and sacrificial feasts of the one who forgets the Lord's praise are all in vain. ॥1॥
ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਉ ਪਰਹਰਿ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
The one who gives up both pride and attachment to Maya and sings the praises of the Lord of the universe,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
Nanak says, such a person is called liberated while alive, free of the grip of vice in this very life. ॥2॥2॥
ਜਾ ਮੈ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ, ਨਾਹੀ ॥
The person within whom there is no worship of the Lord's Name,
ਤਿਹ ਨਰ. ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ; ਯਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
keep this firmly in mind: that person has wasted his life in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ. ਬ੍ਰਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਨਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਸਿ. ਜਾ ਕੋ ॥
The one whose mind is not under his control may bathe at pilgrimage places and keep fasts,
ਨਿਹਫਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਤ ਮੈ. ਯਾ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
but know that such religion of his is fruitless; I tell even him this truth. ॥1॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ; ਭੇਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ. ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
As a stone kept in water is not pierced by the water, which has no effect on it,
ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਹੁ; ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
so know the mortal who is without devotion to the Lord. ॥2॥
ਕਲ ਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਤ; ਗੁਰੁ ਯਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥
The Guru tells this secret of life: in human life one gains release from vice only through the Lord's Name.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਗਰੂਆ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
Nanak says: that person alone is worthy of honour who sings the Lord's praises. ॥3॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The Lord dwells near every being and Himself takes care of all,
but only a rare one who repeats the Name, turning to the Guru, understands this.
ਵਿਣੁ ਭੈ ਪਇਐ; ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Until the fear arises that He is ever near and watching, devotion to the Lord cannot be.
Those dyed in the Name through the Guru's Word ever have spiritual bliss. ॥1॥
The Lord's Name is such a precious thing that it brings deep kinship with Him.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ; ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who obtains it by turning to the Guru, soaking in its relish, receives honour in this world and the next. ॥1॥ Rahao
Everyone talks of knowledge, saying "I have gained knowledge of the Lord, knowledge";
ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ; ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
but the more one argues about it, the more only strife arises.
ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਤੇ; ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Arguing becomes such a habit that one cannot stop.
ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Yet without being dyed in the relish of the Lord's Name there is no release from vice. ॥2॥
ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Deep kinship with the Lord and steady attention on Him all come from the Guru alone.
The one who receives them has a pure way of life, and the eternal Lord dwells in his mind.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੈ; ਪਰੁ ਰਹਤ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
The self-willed person merely talks of knowledge, but his way of life is not pure.
Strayed from the Name, he finds no support to escape the wandering of Maya. ॥3॥
Maya has bound the minds of beings in a net of the arrows of attachment.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਓ; ਬਿਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Though the Lord pervades every body, the poison of attachment to Maya is in each too,
so whoever is born in the world is seen in the grip of spiritual death.
Only by remembering the Lord in the heart is the work worth doing in human life accomplished. ॥4॥
ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
That person alone is truly wise who, through the Guru's Word, has fixed his attention on the Lord's feet.
The self-willed person, ruled by ego, loses his honour.
But what power has a being? The Creator Himself has beings perform His devotion,
and Himself, turning them to the Guru, grants them glory. ॥5॥
Without remembrance a person's life is a dark night; only the manifest light of the Lord makes it bright.
Those cut off from the Name are false, filthy and polluting, leading others astray too.
The Vedas and every scripture proclaim the teaching of devotion aloud.
Whoever hears this teaching again and again and puts faith in it sees the divine Light everywhere. ॥6॥
The Shastras and Simritis too urge firm remembrance of the Name.
Those who remember the Name in the Guru's refuge have peace within, and their way of life becomes excellent.
The self-willed endure the pains of birth and death in the species.
These bonds break only when the one Name is enshrined in the heart. ॥7॥
The one who makes the Lord's Name firm in his heart receives true honour and respect.
I see Him alone everywhere; there is no other like Him.
Seeing Him everywhere I praise Him, and He alone is dear to my mind.
Nanak says: there is no other like the Lord. ॥8॥1॥
832: The intellect of the one strayed from the Name also walks at the mind's bidding,
and this mind thinks only of what the Shastras call virtue and what they call sin.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
The one drunk on the wine of Maya is never sated of it.
Satisfaction and release from attachment to Maya come only when the eternal Lord becomes dear to the mind. ॥1॥
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ; ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
O proud one, see: this body, this wealth, this wife will not stay with you.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Lord's Name nothing goes along with a being. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੀਚਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ; ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
One enjoys the relishes of Maya and indulges the mind's pleasures,
but at death the wealth becomes other people's, and the body a heap of dust.
This whole expanse mixes at last with the dust.
The filth of vice that gathers on the mind does not come off without the Guru's Word. ॥2॥
ਗੀਤ ਰਾਗ ਘਨ ਤਾਲ; ਸਿ ਕੂਰੇ ॥
Strayed from the Name, a person diverts the mind with songs, ragas and rhythms of many kinds, but these are all false efforts,
for without the Name a being is born and dies under the sway of the three qualities and stays far from the Lord's feet.
Through these songs and ragas the looking to others and evil thinking do not depart, nor does the spiritual disease.
The one who, turning to the Guru, sings the Lord's praises is freed from them; His praise is the medicine for these diseases. ॥3॥
Those who wear white loincloths, put marks on their foreheads and rosaries round their necks,
and recite the Vedic mantras, while anger rules within them, are merely like players rehearsing in a theatre.
Those who forget the Lord's Name and drink the wine of attachment to Maya find no peace.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥
Without the Guru there is no devotion, and without devotion no spiritual bliss. ॥4॥
beast, outcast, lowly and wretched: into such species are they made to wander,
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ; ਤਿਨੑ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥
those who have turned their faces away from the Guru.
Bound by attachment to Maya, one stays in the round of birth and death. ॥5॥
Only through the service the Guru teaches does one obtain the treasure of the Name.
The one in whose heart the Lord's Name ever dwells has succeeded in life's journey.
In the Lord's true court no account is asked of him, for nothing is found owing.
The one who accepts the Lord's will succeeds at His door. ॥6॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
When a person meets the Guru, he forms deep kinship with the Lord,
understands the Lord's will and lives content in it.
Understanding the eternal Lord's will, he finds a place at His door.
Through the Guru's Word his round of birth and death ends. ॥7॥
ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ; ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
The one who, through remembrance, stays detached from Maya within regards everything as the Lord's gift.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ; ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
He offers his body and mind to the Lord who gave them.
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ; ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
He escapes the round of birth and death.
Nanak: he stays merged in the eternal Lord. ॥8॥2॥
Bilaval · Ashtpadi · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 10
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The person wrapped in Maya is like a crow, cawing about spiritual wisdom only with the beak of his mouth.
But within this beak-wise man dwell greed, falsehood and pride.
Cut off from the Name, this religious show is in the end exposed. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
In the Guru's refuge the Lord's Name comes to dwell in the mind and heart.
ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਹੋਰ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who meets the Guru, the Guru has him repeat the Lord's Name; apart from love of the Name, all other love is false. ॥1॥ Rahao
Do the work the Guru has told you: the remembrance of the Name.
Forming deep kinship with the Word of the Lord's praise, dwell in the home of spiritual poise.
Joined to the eternal Lord's Name, you will gain glory in this world and the next. ॥2॥
The one who understands nothing of spiritual life himself, yet goes on instructing others,
is blind of mind, stumbling blindly on the path of spiritual life and doing the deeds of the blind.
ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ; ਠਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
How can such a person find the Lord's door, home, mansion or dwelling? ॥3॥
Serve and worship the Lord, the Knower of hearts,
ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
whose Light is present in every body.
Nothing can be hidden from Him. ॥4॥
833: The one who, through the Word of the eternal Lord's praise, forms deep kinship with the eternal Name
has his self merged in the Lord's self, and pride ends within him.
In the Guru's refuge he ever repeats the Lord's Name. ॥5॥
Staying in the Guru's refuge, the evil thinking of attachment to Maya departs.
All faults are cut away and the sinful mind is consumed.
Kept from vice, the body stays pure as gold, and the soul stays merged in the Lord's Light. ॥6॥
Meeting the Guru, great glory is received in this world and the next.
The Guru cuts away every pain and enshrines the Lord's Name in the heart.
Dyed in the Name, one ever enjoys spiritual bliss. ॥7॥
Won over by the Guru's teaching, one's conduct becomes excellent.
Won over by the Guru's teaching, the door of release from vice is found.
Nanak: won over by the Guru's teaching, one becomes able to give one's whole family the support of the Lord's Name. ॥8॥1॥3॥
Bilaval · Ashtpadis · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 11
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ. ਹਉ ਮੇਟੈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗੀਤ ਗਵਈਆ ॥
The one who sings songs of the nectar of the Lord's Name at all times merges his self into the Lord's self and wipes out ego within.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੧॥
The one who, in the Guru's refuge, stays absorbed in the Name has his body kept pure as gold from vice, and his soul merges in the Light of the fearless Lord. ॥1॥
ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਮਈਆ ॥
The Name of the beautiful Lord has become the support of my life.
ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I cannot live even a moment without His Name; in the Guru's refuge I keep reciting the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਏਕੁ ਗਿਰਹੁ. ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
This body is a single house with ten doors, through which the five thieves, lust, anger, greed, attachment and pride, break in day and night.
ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਖਬਰਿ. ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੨॥
They carry off all the wealth of righteousness and spiritual life, and the blind self-willed one does not even notice. ॥2॥
ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕਿ ਭਰਿਆ; ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਈਆ ॥
The body is a fortress of gold full of the rubies of lofty virtues; those who stay awake, fixing their attention on the Lord, the essence of wisdom, save that wealth.
ਤਸਕਰ ਹੇਰੂ. ਆਇ ਲੁਕਾਨੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੩॥
Thieves and robbers, lust and the rest, come and hide in it to loot those jewels; the wakeful catch and bind them through the Guru's Word. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ; ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ. ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਈਆ ॥
The Lord's Name is a great ship, and the Guru's Word its boatman; the Guru carries across the one who boards it.
ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੪॥
Death, the toll-collector, does not come near him, and no thief such as lust can break in. ॥4॥
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
My mind now sings the Lord's praises ever, day and night; praising Him again and again, I cannot find the end of His praise.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ; ਮਿਲਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ. ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਈਆ ॥੫॥
In the Guru's refuge my mind settles at the Lord's feet alone; I meet the Sustainer of the world and beat the drum of victory, caring nothing for what people say. ॥5॥
ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਈਆ ॥
Beholding the Lord everywhere with my eyes, my mind is satisfied, and my ears keep hearing the Guru's Bani, the Guru's Word.
ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਭੀਨੇ; ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਵਈਆ ॥੬॥
Hearing His praise again and again, my soul stays soaked in the nectar of the Name, and with great delight I sing the praises of the Lord. ॥6॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ; ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
Beings under the sway of Maya's three qualities stay caught in attachment to Maya; the one who turns to the Guru reaches the fourth state, beyond Maya's sway.
ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਈਆ ॥੭॥
He looks on all with one loving gaze and knows all as equal; he plainly sees the Lord alone spread out everywhere. ॥7॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਈਆ ॥
The one who turns to the Guru understands that the unseen Lord Himself is present everywhere: the Lord's Name is everywhere and His Light is in all.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
Nanak: those on whom the Lord, Merciful to the meek, is merciful stay merged in His Name through loving devotion. ॥8॥1॥4॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਗੰਧਈਆ ॥
Remember the Lord's Name; it is cooling water, and it is the fragrance of sandalwood that makes all the vegetation fragrant.
834: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ. ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮੈ ਹਿਰਡ ਪਲਾਸ, ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
Joining the holy congregation the highest spiritual state is gained; as castor and palas trees become fragrant near sandalwood, so beings like me become lofty through the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
Keep repeating the Name of the Lord, Master of the world, Lord of the universe, Master of the earth.
ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ; ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who take His refuge are saved, as the Lord carried Prahlad across and merged him at His feet. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਊਤਮ; ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੁਈਆ ॥
Among all vegetation sandalwood is the finest, and every plant growing near sandalwood becomes sandalwood.
ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ. ਊਭ ਸੁਕ ਹੂਏ; ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ, ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
But false beings cut off from the Lord dry up while still standing; pride dwells in their minds, and separated from Him they stay far away. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਈਆ ॥
Only the Creator Himself knows what the Lord is like and how great He is; the Lord Himself has made the whole order of the world.
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ. ਮਿਟਈਆ ॥੩॥
By that order the one who meets the Guru becomes gold, pure of life; the writ written from the Lord's court cannot be erased by one's own effort. ॥3॥
ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ; ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਖੁਲੑਈਆ ॥
Within the Guru lie oceans of devotion, its treasuries open; by following the Guru's teaching one obtains the jewels of lofty virtue.
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਇਕ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਜੀ; ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਨ ਭਈਆ ॥੪॥
Falling at the Guru's feet, love for the One Lord has arisen in me, and I am never sated of singing His praises. ॥4॥
ਪਰਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ. ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ; ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਕਹੀਆ ॥
The one who ever meditates on the Lord comes to the deepest longing for Him; I have told of the love that formed in me singing His praises.
ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ, ਪਰੈ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
So repeat His Name again and again, every instant, every moment; yet the Lord is beyond the beyond, and no one can reach His far shore. ॥5॥
ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ; ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
The Shastras, Vedas and Puranas proclaim: practise religion; they insist on the six religious duties.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ; ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਭਾਰਿ ਬੁਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
The self-willed are ruined in this hypocrisy and wandering; the boat of their life sinks in the wave of greed under the weight of it. ॥6॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
Repeat the Name, and through the Name alone attain the high spiritual state; for the one who turns to the Guru, the Name itself is the teaching of the Simritis and Shastras; keep it firm within.
ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ. ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
When ego departs, one becomes pure; when, in the Guru's refuge, one is won over by the Name, the highest state is attained. ॥7॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਈਆ ॥
O Lord, this whole world, every colour and form, is Yours; to whatever You attach beings, those deeds they do.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੰਤ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਾਜਹਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
Nanak, say: beings are Your instruments and sound as You play them; on whatever path pleases You, on that path they walk. ॥8॥2॥5॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਈਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice again and again to the Guru, the great true Being; in the Guru's refuge I remember the unreachable Lord, beyond the senses.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਿ ਵਸਾਏ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
The Guru has made the Lord's Name dwell in my every breath; touching the Guru's feet, I stay merged in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
The Guru has made the Lord's Name the support of His servant's life.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਵਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Holding the Guru's hem I walk the path of life; by the Guru's grace I have found the Lord's door. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਧਰਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਈਆ ॥
This human body is the field where deeds are sown; as butter is drawn by churning milk, so, in the Guru's refuge, refining one's deeds again and again, the essence of spiritual life is drawn out.
ਲਾਲੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਈਆ ॥੨॥
In whatever heart the Guru reveals the ruby, the jewel of the Name, love comes to dwell in that vessel. ॥2॥
ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ; ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਭਈਆ ॥
Live as the servant of the servants of the servants of those who have become the Lord's own devotees.
ਮਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਈਆ ॥੩॥
I have offered my mind and intellect and placed them before the Guru; by the Guru's grace I praise the Lord whose form cannot be told. ॥3॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਤਿਖਈਆ ॥
The self-willed stay caught in attachment to Maya, and their minds keep burning with the thirst of craving.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ. ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਈਆ ॥੪॥
The one who, through the Guru's teaching, found the life-giving water of the Name had the fire within put out; the Guru's Word put it out. ॥4॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੂਰ ਵਜਈਆ ॥
The one whose mind dances before the Guru, going where the Guru leads, has within him the unbroken music of the Word of praise playing.
835: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਣ. ਹਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
He praises the Lord day and night and, keeping the Lord's feet ever in his heart, keeps the steps of life in rhythm. ॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ; ਰਸਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਈਆ ॥
The one whose mind, dyed in the Lord's love, keeps singing, and who with relish repeats the Word in love of the Lord, the source of relishes,
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੬॥
in his own heart-home a most pure stream of the Name's nectar trickles; whoever has drunk it has found spiritual bliss. ॥6॥
ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ. ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ ॥
The proud one who performs prescribed rituals through the mind's stubbornness is like children building houses of sand.
ਆਵੈ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
A wave of the sea comes, and in an instant they collapse, grain by grain. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ ॥
The Lord Himself is the lake and the ocean; this whole world is a play He has staged.
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
As the waves of water are water and merge back into water, so, Nanak, the beautiful Lord alone pervades all. ॥8॥3॥6॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ. ਮਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
Those with whom the Guru is pleased wear that pleasure as yogic earrings in the mind, and the Guru's Word made firm within is the ash smeared on their bodies.
ਅਮਰ ਪਿੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੧॥
Dwelling in the company of the Guru, their bodies become immortal, and both birth and death come to an end. ॥1॥
O my mind, stay joined to the holy congregation and pray:
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧਉ; ਮੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Madhusudan, O Madho, be merciful, that every moment I may wash the Guru's feet. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤਜੈ ਗਿਰਸਤੁ. ਭਇਆ ਬਨ. ਵਾਸੀ; ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
One may abandon household life and dwell in the forest, yet the mind does not stay still even a moment, however one tries.
ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਤਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੨॥
This wandering mind comes home only when, after running and running, one takes the refuge of the Lord and the Guru. ॥2॥
ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ; ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
One may leave daughters and sons and become a sannyasi, yet still build hope upon hope in the mind;
ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ. ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੩॥
building hope upon hope, he does not understand true living; only through the Guru's Word, free of worldly hopes, is spiritual bliss found. ॥3॥
ਉਪਜੀ ਤਰਕ. ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ; ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
Disgust with the world may arise and one become a naked ascetic, yet the mind keeps running in all ten directions;
ਪ੍ਰਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ. ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ, ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ, ਦਇਆ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੪॥
he roams the earth, but his craving does not end; only by joining the Guru's company is the Lord, the home of mercy, found. ॥4॥
ਆਸਣ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਮਨਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚੇਟਕ ਚੇਟਕਈਆ ॥
Accomplished yogis learn many postures, yet in their minds they beg for miraculous powers and wonders to impress people.
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
Their minds find no satisfaction, contentment or peace; only meeting the Guru does one find satisfaction and true success through the Lord's Name. ॥5॥
ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ; ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ ॥
Born of eggs, of the womb, of sweat, sprouting from the earth: the Lord has created all beings of every colour and form.
ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ; ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
Whoever takes the Guru's refuge is saved, be he Khatri, Brahmin, Shudra, Vaishya or the lowest outcaste. ॥6॥
ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ; ਅਉਜਾਤਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ ॥
Namdev, Jaidev, Kabir, Trilochan, and Ravidas the low-caste cobbler,
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ. ਸੈਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਈਆ ॥੭॥
Dhanna the Jat and Sain: whoever joined the company of the saints was blessed and met the merciful Lord. ॥7॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
The Lord, Lover of devotion, has ever kept the honour of His saints and taken their side.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਈਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੭॥
Nanak: those who take the refuge of the Lord, the Life of the world, the Lord in His mercy protects. ॥8॥4॥7॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਉਠੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ. ਮਨਿ ਤੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
Hearing the Guru's words, arrows of separation have struck my mind, and a thirst for the sight of God has risen within me.
836: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੧॥
Only my own mind knows the pain of my mind; what can anyone else know of another's pain? ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹਨਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਈਆ ॥
O Lord, the enchanting Guru has won my mind over.
ਹਉ ਆਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ. ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ; ਹਉ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੋਇ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Seeing the Guru I have lost my cleverness and my wits; I am no longer my own, overwhelmed and fallen at his feet. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਉ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਫਿਰਉ. ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ; ਮੈ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਈਆ ॥
A great longing to behold God has arisen in my mind, and I have gone searching through all lands and countries.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਈਆ ॥੨॥
I would cut up my mind and body and offer them before the Guru, who has shown me the path to the Lord God. ॥2॥
ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
If anyone brings me a message from God, it tastes sweet in my heart, mind and body.
ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ. ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੩॥
I would cut off my head and place it beneath the feet of anyone who unites me with the Lord God. ॥3॥
ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ; ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
Come, come, my friend, let us go and win God's love; with the charms of virtue let us attain the Lord God.
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ ॥੪॥
"Lover of devotion" is said to be His Name; let us take His refuge and fall at His door. ॥4॥
ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ; ਮਨਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ ॥
The bride who makes forgiveness her adornment and lights in her mind the lamp of spiritual understanding from the Guru
ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
pleases God, and my God enjoys her with great delight; I would offer my life again and again before that Husband-Lord. ॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਹੈ ਬਨਿਆ; ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀਚੂਰੁ, ਵਡ ਗਹਨ ਗਹਨਈਆ ॥
I have put on my neck the necklace of the Lord's Name, and made my mind, beautified by remembrance, the finest ornament, a pearl-studded jewel.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ, ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਈਆ ॥੬॥
I have spread the bed of faith in the Lord's Name; He has become so dear to my mind that I am sure He cannot leave me. ॥6॥
ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਫੋਕਟ ਫੋਕਟਈਆ ॥
If the Husband-Lord says one thing and the bride does another, all her adornment is in vain, utterly hollow.
ਕੀਓ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੀਓ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ. ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
She adorned herself to meet Him, but God took the devoted wedded bride, and spit fell on the face of the other. ॥7॥
ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ. ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ. ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਈਆ ॥
O God, we are Your handmaidens and You the unreachable Master of the earth; what can we do? We are ever in Your power.
ਦਇਆ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੮॥
Nanak, say: O Lord, show mercy to us poor ones and keep us; keep us merged in the Guru's refuge. ॥8॥5॥8॥
ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਈਆ ॥
In my mind and body is love for the unreachable Master, and moment by moment a great longing for Him rises in my mind.
ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ; ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥
Seeing the Guru, the mind's longing is fulfilled, as a raindrop falls into the mouth of the rainbird crying "Priu, priu". ॥1॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਈਆ ॥
Come, my friend, let us sit together and hear the Lord's praises.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ; ਮੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru in his mercy unites one with God; before him I offer my head again and again. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਇਕ ਬੇਦਨ; ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ. ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥
In every pore, in my mind and body, there is the ache of separation; without seeing God I find no rest.
ਬੈਦਕ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ; ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
The physicians go astray feeling my pulse; it is the pain of God's love that has risen in my heart, mind and body. ॥2॥
ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ. ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
As an addict nears death without his drug, so I cannot live even a moment without my Beloved.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ; ਤਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਭਾਵੈ, ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਈਆ ॥੩॥
The brides who thirst for God find no other pleasing but the Lord. ॥3॥
ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ; ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
If anyone would come and unite me with my God, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that one.
ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ. ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ; ਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੪॥
When one takes the refuge of the True, True Guru, the Guru unites with the Lord those separated through countless births. ॥4॥
837: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ. ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ, ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਈਆ ॥
There is one bed of the heart, and the one Master God dwells on it; but the self-willed bride cannot find His mansion and only wanders.
ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ. ਸਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਢੀਲ. ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
If she comes to the Guru's refuge crying "Guru, Guru", God comes and meets her without a moment's delay. ॥5॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਵਧਾਏ; ਮਨਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਪਟ ਲੋਭਈਆ ॥
But one who, leaving the Guru and the Name, keeps multiplying rituals has only hypocrisy, deceit and greed at work in the mind.
ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟਾ ਜਨਮਿਆ; ਪਿਤਾ ਤਾਹਿ. ਕਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਈਆ ॥੬॥
When a son is born in the house of a prostitute, whose name can be given as his father? ॥6॥
ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ. ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ, ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮਈਆ ॥
Those who have come into this birth having practised devotion in a past birth, in them the Guru has sown the seed of devotion to the Lord at every moment.
ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੭॥
Practising devotion at every moment they found the Lord, when they merged in the Lord's Name. ॥7॥
ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਹਿੰਦੀ ਪੀਸਾਈ; ਆਪੇ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਈਆ ॥

Devotion is like grinding henna: God Himself, bringing the mind to His feet again and again, has had the henna of devotion ground, and Himself, mixing it into colour and love, has joined them to His feet.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਢਿ ਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੨॥੧॥੬॥੯॥
Nanak: those on whom the Master showed grace, He took by the arm and drew out of the world-ocean. ॥8॥6॥2॥1॥6॥9॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ. ਨ ਕਹੀ, ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ; ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ. ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
The glory of my God cannot be told; His glory cannot be told.
Giving up other supports, I have taken His refuge. ॥1॥ Rahao
To the beautiful feet of the infinite Lord
Those in whose minds love for Him is formed
leave His door to go nowhere else. ॥1॥
Uttering the Lord's Name with the tongue
burns away the filth of countless sins and vices.
Boarding this boat of the saints, the Name, many are saved from drowning in vice,
To create in the mind the cord of loving devotion to the Lord's feet
is the pure way of life the saints teach.
Those who form this love leave all sins and vices behind,
and meet the Lord God, the Formless One. ॥3॥
The sight of the wondrous Lord
is gained by tasting the relish of the Lord, perfect bliss.
One does not waver before the attacks of vice in this world or the next
if the Lord God dwells in the heart. ॥4॥
Those do not dwell in hell
who, remembering God, the treasure of virtues, ever keep Him in their hearts.
They do not see Death with their eyes,
who are enraptured hearing the unbroken flute of His praise. ॥5॥
The devotees stay in the refuge of the Lord, the valiant Sustainer,
the merciful Lord who is under the sway of His devotees.
Even the Vedas cannot find His secret,
and all the sages ever serve and worship Him. ॥6॥
He removes the pain and suffering of the poor,
He whose service and devotion are very hard.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one knows the limit of His being.
He Himself is present in water, on land and in the sky. ॥7॥
O God, I bow at Your door hundreds of thousands of times.
Defeated by all other supports, I have fallen at Your door.
O God, make me the dust of the feet of Your saints;
Nanak, say: fulfil this longing of mine. ॥8॥1॥
Pray thus: O God, end my round of birth and death.
Giving up hope elsewhere, I have fallen at Your door.
Have mercy, that holding the feet and the hem of Your saints,
my mind may find Your love sweet, O Lord.
838: In Your mercy attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Nanak, keep remembering the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
O Master of the meek, merciful one, my Lord, Master of the meek, merciful one,
I beg for the dust of the feet of Your saints. ॥1॥ Rahao
This world is a well of attachment to Maya;
the pitch darkness of spiritual ignorance is beguiling me.
O God, take hold of my arm and save me,
and give me Your Name, O Lord.
O God, apart from You I have no other place of support.
Nanak, pray: O God, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Your Name. ॥2॥
My body is bound in greed and attachment;
without worship of You it is turning to dust.
Death's messengers seem most terrifying to me,
and Chitr and Gupt know all my deeds.
Day and night too bear witness that my deeds are evil.
Nanak, say: O Lord, I have come to Your refuge. ॥3॥
O Destroyer of fear, O Lord,
in Your mercy save me, the sinner, from sin.
O Lord, they can be forgiven at no door but Yours.
O Master, I have thought only of Your support.
Nanak, say: O Lord, take hold of my arm and protect me, giving me Your hand. ॥4॥
O Lord, treasure of virtues, Sustainer of the earth,
may love for You and thirst for Your sight remain in my mind;
O Lord of the universe, fulfil my hope.
Without Your sight I cannot live even a moment.
Nanak, say: only by great fortune does anyone attain union with You. ॥5॥
O God, I have no other support but You.
My mind loves Your feet as the chakor loves the moon,
as the bumblebee becomes one with the lotus,
as the chakvi longs for the sunrise:
Nanak, say: so do I thirst for Your feet, O God. ॥6॥
As a young wife holds her husband dear as life,
as the greedy man delights in the gift of wealth,
as a mother loves her son,
so, Nanak, ever remember the Lord with love. ॥7॥
As moths bound by love fall upon the lamp,
as the thief steals without shame,
as the elephant is bound by lust,
as the sensual man is gripped by his pursuits,
as the gambler's vice never leaves him,
so, Nanak, keep this mind joined to the Lord in love. ॥8॥
As the deer loves the sound of the hunter's bell,
as the rainbird longs for the rain,
so the Lord's servant lives his life in the holy congregation,
worships the Lord of the universe with love,
utters the Name with his tongue,
and, Nanak, begs for the gift of the Lord's sight. ॥9॥
The one who sings the Lord's praises, hears them, and writes them and gives them to others
attains the Lord, the Giver of all fruits,
The Lord's feet are the ship that carries across those
who, joining the Guru's company, sing His praises.
and, Nanak, they stay in the Lord's refuge, at His door. ॥10॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The first day: the One Lord is unique and apart, with no particular home.
He is immortal, unborn, with no caste and no bond of Maya.
He is unreachable and beyond the senses, without form or feature.
Yet searching and searching, He can be seen in every body.
839: ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Guru who, seeing Him in every body, shows Him to others too.
By the Guru's grace alone I can reach that highest state of beholding Him in all. ॥1॥
What chant should I chant other than remembrance of the Lord of the world?
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, remembering Him, His mansion and home come into view. ॥1॥ Rahao
Those who forget the Lord and cling to the love of another regret it in the end.
Bound at Death's door, they keep coming and going.
ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਵਹਿ; ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Empty-handed they come and empty-handed they go, having gathered no capital of remembrance and service.
Spiritual death stands over their heads, and they keep suffering its blows.
Without the Guru's Word no one escapes spiritual death.
By outward religious show there is no release from vice. ॥2॥
The Lord Himself is eternal, and by His command He Himself created this universe.
He destroys this universe, creates it again, destroys it again, and creates it anew.
ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਕੀਏ; ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
He made the earth and sky as a place for beings to dwell.
He made night and day, and put fear and love within beings.
The One who made all beings, having made them, Himself watches over them.
There is no other creator of this universe. ॥3॥
The third day: the Lord created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,
and created gods, goddesses and countless other beings.
He created so many luminous beings that they cannot be counted.
The One who fashioned this creation alone knows its worth,
and knowing its worth, loves it and pervades it everywhere, caring for it.
Whom can I call near to Him and whom far? He pervades all alike. ॥4॥
The fourth day: the Lord Himself created the four Vedas,
the four sources of creation and the different tongues of beings.
He created the eighteen Puranas, the six Shastras and the three qualities of Maya.
Only the one to whom He Himself gives understanding understands this.
The one who ends the sway of the three qualities and dwells in the fourth state, spiritual poise,
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
Nanak prays, I am the servant of that person. ॥5॥
The fifth day: those beings He created who are absorbed only in the five elements have strayed from the true way of life like demons.
The all-pervading Lord Himself is beyond the senses and untouched.
Many beings, through wandering, are hungry with craving and thirsty with attachment to Maya.
But some fortunate ones, tasting the relish of the Name and joined to the Guru's Word, are sated from Maya.
ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Some are dyed in the Lord's love, and some, bringing on spiritual death, have become dust.
ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ; ਸਾਚੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੬॥
Some, seeing the eternal Lord ever present, stay at His door, at home in His presence. ॥6॥
The one in love only with the world's things finds neither honour nor name anywhere.
The one whose mind has become black as a crow with vice can never become pure while caught in Maya.
When a bird is shut in a cage,
it may flutter at the bars, but it cannot get free.
It is freed only when its master frees it; so the Master Himself frees the being imprisoned in attachment to Maya.
He joins him to the Guru's teaching and makes devotion firm in his heart. ॥7॥
The sixth day: six religious garbs (yogis, sannyasis and the like) were made as ways to meet God,
but the unbroken Word of His praise resounds apart from them all.
ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
If someone pleases God, He calls him into His presence, joining him to His feet.
When one threads his mind into the Lord through the Word of praise, then he receives honour.
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ; ਖਪਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
Those who keep putting on religious garbs only waste away and burn in the fire of craving.
Through the true Name, those who become one with the True One merge in the True One. ॥8॥
The seventh day: the one within whom service and contentment flourish,
his five senses, mind and intellect are filled with the pure water of the Name.
Keeping the True Lord in his heart, he bathes in pure conduct;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
through the Guru's Word he carries all his faculties across, beyond the sway of vice.
The True One dwells in his mind and on his tongue, and he stays absorbed in love;
the true Name is his passport, so nothing blocks his way. ॥9॥
The eighth day: the one who keeps under control the intellect that craves the eight yogic powers,
and by His grace ever worships the pure, True Lord,
in whose heart the three qualities of passion, purity and darkness have no hold,
in that very heart dwells the Immaculate Lord, the true Name.
ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
The one whose mind stays absorbed in Him,
Nanak says, spiritual death does not devour him. ॥10॥
ਨਾਉ ਨਉਮੀ; ਨਵੇ ਨਾਥ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਾ ॥
The ninth day: the One whose Name the nine Nath masters and all beings of the earth repeat,
the true Master is He who pervades every body, the Almighty.
840: He is the mother of the world; this whole world is that mother's child.
Bow to God alone: He is the source of all and the protector of all.
He is from the beginning, from the start of the ages; He is now and ever will be.
He is beyond the beyond, and has the power to do everything. ॥11॥
The tenth day: repeating the Name is the true charity and bathing,
and deep kinship with the Lord's virtues is the lasting daily pilgrim's bath.
ਸਚਿ. ਮੈਲੁ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Joined to the True One, the mind takes no stain; its wandering and fear run away,
as quickly as a weak thread snaps.
Know the world's ties to be like that weak thread.
Keep your mind steady in the true Name and enjoy spiritual bliss. ॥12॥
The eleventh day: the one who enshrines the One Lord in the heart
rids himself of cruelty, possessiveness and attachment to Maya.
The one who keeps this fast gains its fruit: he keeps examining his own spiritual life.
But engrossed in a showy fast, one cannot see the Source of all.
The Lord is stainless, needs no food, and is pure in essence;
those who become one with that pure True Lord are not stained by vice either. ॥13॥
Wherever I look, I see the One Lord alone.
He has created all these beings of every kind.
Eating only fruit on a fast does not bring the fast's true fruit;
eating foods of many flavours instead, one loses the fast's real savour.
Such a person stays entangled in the false greed of Maya.
The one who turns to the Guru and earns the true Name is set free. ॥14॥
The twelfth day: they are the true renunciates whose mind wears, as it were, all twelve marks of the sects,
who stay awake day and night and never sleep in attachment to Maya.
The one who stays awake through the Guru's teaching,
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
and, alert, keeps his mind fixed on the Lord, is not devoured by spiritual death.
They have killed all their enemies and become true renunciates.
Nanak prays: they have fixed their attention there, on the Lord. ॥15॥
The twelfth day: the one who knows how to share love among people as his charity,
who brings the mind wandering outside back within,
who lives free of desire, keeping that as his fast,
and utters the Lord's Name with his mouth, is chanting the true unspoken chant.
The one who knows the One Lord to dwell in all three worlds,
and stays deeply linked with the True One, is practising every purity and every discipline. ॥16॥
The thirteenth day: this body is like a tree on the seashore.
But the one who makes the life-giving Name his root reaches the summit, God's feet, by the thread of his attention.
ਡਰ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਬੂਡੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Such a one does not die spiritually from worldly fears, nor does he drown in the sea of vice.
But the one with no fear of God loses his honour and brings spiritual death on himself.
ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ; ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
The one who makes his home in the fear of God and keeps that fear in the home of his heart,
to whom the True Lord becomes dear in his mind, dwells on the throne of exalted spiritual life. ॥17॥
The fourteenth day: when one finds the fourth state, beyond Maya,
then passion, darkness and purity, the three qualities, all merge into it.
The heat of the mind merges into the home of peace, as the sun into the moon,
and one comes to value the way of union with the Lord.
The Lord who pervades the fourteen worlds and the netherworlds,
who pervades the continents and galaxies: in Him one then keeps his attention fixed. ॥18॥
The night of the new moon: as the moon is hidden in the sky, so the Lord dwells hidden in every heart.
O seeker of spiritual wisdom, you will understand this only by keeping the Guru's Word in your mind.
As the moon lights the whole sky, so God's light gives life to all three worlds.
The Creator Himself creates all beings and takes care of them.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦੀਸੈ; ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
The one who gains this understanding from the Guru remains ever absorbed in Him.
But the self-willed, gone astray, keep coming and going in birth and death. ॥19॥
ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਥਾਪਿ; ਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Making God's feet and His door his firm support, and dwelling in that place, one's life becomes beautiful.
When one meets the True Guru, he begins to examine his own spiritual life.
In the heart where worldly hopes once lived, hope is wholly gone;
the vessel of duality and the mind's desires breaks.
Such a one stays detached from the net of possessiveness.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
Nanak prays: I am the servant of such a person. ॥20॥1॥
